name: drm_publish_score
description: Transcribe the supplied sheet photo into playable notes, then seal and upload the score to the signed-in DrMusic account. Use rests as gaps, simultaneous starts for chords, and both hands where written. Ask about unreadable notes before uploading. The returned URL opens the score.

name: drm_get_piano_score
description: Read one owned piano score with its original key when provided and all written notes. numberedUrl downloads printable numbered notation when opened by the owner. If needed append &key= with the URL-encoded user-confirmed key, e.g. Bb major. Each page has up to 256 performed and 256 written notes. Follow next with the same id and revision until null. Append the first measure at noteOffset (performed) and notationOffset (written, default zero) when continuing inside a dense measure.

startMeasure.description: First measure on this page, one-based.

revision.description: Use the revision from the first page to keep one consistent score.

name: drm_create_numbered_score
description: Create an independent, playable numbered-notation score in the signed-in owner’s private library from their existing piano score. Return the new url. Repeating the same source version, title and key returns the existing score. Supply key only when confirmed by the user.

name: drm_store_private_attachment
description: Store one private original on a score you own at a fixed position. Supply exactly one source: legacyFile for an approved migration, or pdfBase64 for a local PDF. Returns the length and SHA-256 calculated by reading the stored bytes. A different original cannot replace an occupied position.

filename.description: Original basename, including the file extension.

legacyFile.description: For the approved legacy-library owner only. Basename under the fixed legacy /uploads/ directory.

pdfBase64.description: Standard padded base64 of a user-selected local PDF, at most 768 KiB decoded.

name: drm_correct_drum_score
description: Correct an existing drum chart owned by the signed-in user at its original ID. Pass the current revision and either complete verified measures or hitMarks to add only verified accents by one-based measure and zero-based hitIndex. Omitting sourceNotes preserves them. Re-read after a conflict or interrupted request.

name: drm_add_piano_notation
description: Add verified source notation to an owned piano score or numbered snapshot at its existing ID. Both accept notationMarks (verified accents, fermatas, ties and slurs), original written notes, timed chord symbols and verse lyrics. Use the target score’s own ID and revision. Written notes are added only when the measure lacks a written layer and never replace performed notes. Read expectedRevision with drm_get_piano_score first. Use only verified original notation. The batch is atomic. Existing identical data is acknowledged. New text anchors or verses can be appended. A conflicting group at the same beat and verse is rejected. Preserve the order of notes and same-beat text on retries.

name: drm_set_guitar_video
description: Set or replace the music video on one owned guitar chart using its existing ID. Verify the artist and song first. To remove the link pass null. Changing the video affects its shared view.

name: drm_attach_original
description: Attach one private JPEG or PNG photo to an existing owned score. Replacing the attachment preserves the playable score. Use standard base64 without a data URL, up to 768 KiB decoded. For a larger photo use the website (up to 8 MiB).

name: drm_list_scores
description: List the titles and IDs of the signed-in DrMusic account’s scores.
